title: Procurement of Metal Halide Lamps, Lamp Holders and Electronic Ballasts for Various Lighthouses
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of metal halide lamps (35-150 W), lamp holders and electronic ballasts for various lighthouses, delivered to Deep Bhavan, Cochin, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: 35 W metal halide lamp, single ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
70 W metal halide lamp, single ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W metal halide lamp, single ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W metal halide lamp, double ended, day white, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent
150 W double ended metal halide lamp holder
35/70/150 W double ended metal halide lamp holder
Electronic ballast for 35 W metal halide lamp, preferably Osram/Philips/Havells or equivalent

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Basic cost and taxes to be shown separately. L1 on consolidated total. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory supply. Delivery to Deep Bhavan, Cochin including loading, unloading and freight.

period.completion: Supply within 30 days from date of supply order
period.bid_validity: 60 days from date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties, shops or Government undertakings
PAN card and GST registration certificate to be submitted with quotation
specs: Metal halide lamps day white, single/double ended, 35/70/150 W; reputed make conforming to Indian standards
